evidence.title: 'Wear more clothes if it's cold,' schools in Northern Ireland told as energy bills rise

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Authority energy-saving guidance for Northern Ireland schools
occurrences.quote_span: Staff and pupils have also been advised to "wear more clothes" rather than turn the heating thermostat up if it is cold.
occurrences.speaker: Education Authority
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Holy Evangelists Primary School heating policy and statement by Claire Robinson
occurrences.quote_span: "We can't play around with the heating."
occurrences.speaker: Claire Robinson
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Rathcoole Primary statement by Emma Quinn and school energy-policy records
occurrences.quote_span: "We're suddenly expected to jump and to fix a problem that is so systemic, it's just not good enough."
occurrences.speaker: Emma Quinn
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Tullygally Primary School site and accommodation records
occurrences.quote_span: "In addition, our site is particularly spread out due to the accommodation and operational requirements associated with our specialist provision.
occurrences.speaker: Kirsty Logan-Hall
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Tullygally Primary School energy-use policies and statements by Kirsty Logan-Hall
occurrences.quote_span: The principal of Tullygally Primary School in Craigavon, Kirsty Logan-Hall, said that the school was "committed to promoting responsible energy consumption and regularly reinforce good practice with staff and pupils".
occurrences.speaker: Kirsty Logan-Hall
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Authority school electricity bill projections
occurrences.quote_span: Meanwhile, total school electricity bills are expected to rise from £23.8m to £25.1m in the same time period.
occurrences.speaker: Education Authority
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Authority school energy bill projections
occurrences.quote_span: The authority has said that school gas and electricity bills are set to rise by about £8m by March 2027.
occurrences.speaker: Education Authority
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Authority school gas bill projections
occurrences.quote_span: It said that total school gas bills were expected to go up by 60% from £10.7m to £17m by March 2027.
occurrences.speaker: Education Authority
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Holy Evangelists Primary School building and heating records
occurrences.quote_span: Parts of the school are relatively new and have underfloor heating.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Holy Evangelists Primary School energy bills and statement by Claire Robinson
occurrences.quote_span: Meanwhile, the principal of Holy Evangelists Primary School in Dunmurry, Claire Robinson, said that energy costs were "ferocious".
occurrences.speaker: Claire Robinson
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Rathcoole Primary energy practices and statement by Emma Quinn
occurrences.quote_span: "Putting this pressure onto us at the minute is ridiculous, when we are eco schools, we are doing all of these, we are turning off lights, but yet this lands in on our doorstep.
occurrences.speaker: Emma Quinn
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Holy Evangelists Primary School energy performance certificate and heating-cost records
occurrences.quote_span: Robinson said that although the school was relatively new it had been given an energy efficiency rating of D due to the costs involved in running the heating system.
occurrences.speaker: Claire Robinson
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Holy Evangelists Primary School heating controls and statement by Claire Robinson
occurrences.quote_span: "We can't just turn the heating off in some areas of the school."
occurrences.speaker: Claire Robinson
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Tullygally Primary School building records
occurrences.quote_span: "The school operates from an older building which presents inherent energy efficiency challenges.
occurrences.speaker: Kirsty Logan-Hall
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Tullygally Primary School operating arrangements
occurrences.quote_span: "This necessitates the heating, lighting and ongoing use of multiple areas across the site throughout the school day to ensure appropriate learning environments, accessibility and pupil welfare.
occurrences.speaker: Kirsty Logan-Hall
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Tullygally Primary School energy-use records and statement by Kirsty Logan-Hall
occurrences.quote_span: "However, our ability to achieve significant reductions in energy usage is constrained by the nature of our estate," she said.
occurrences.speaker: Kirsty Logan-Hall
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Tullygally Primary School energy-use and safeguarding records
occurrences.quote_span: "It is important to recognise that there is limited scope for reducing energy consumption without adversely impacting the quality of provision, staff working conditions or the wellbeing of pupils, including those with additional needs."
occurrences.speaker: Kirsty Logan-Hall
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Authority energy-saving measures for Northern Ireland schools
occurrences.quote_span: Among the measures suggested to schools are cutting heating use by an hour a day and switching off classroom lights to use natural daylight instead.
occurrences.speaker: Education Authority
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Authority guidance to Northern Ireland schools
occurrences.quote_span: Schools have been told by the Education Authority (EA) that increasing costs will affect school energy bills and to reduce heating and lighting "wherever possible".
occurrences.speaker: Education Authority
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Authority guidance to Northern Ireland schools
occurrences.quote_span: Staff and pupils at schools across Northern Ireland have been told to "wear more clothes" if it is cold in order to cut heating bills.
occurrences.speaker: Education Authority
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Rathcoole Primary maintenance records and statement by Emma Quinn
occurrences.quote_span: Meanwhile, Emma Quinn from Rathcoole Primary told BBC Good Morning Ulster that the "lack of maintenance" has an impact on schools, adding that pupils have a right to come into a warm school after being outside.
occurrences.speaker: Emma Quinn
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Authority letter and instructions to Northern Ireland schools
occurrences.quote_span: "Given the scale of the anticipated cost increases, we are asking all schools to review their energy usage and identify opportunities to reduce consumption wherever possible," the EA said.
occurrences.speaker: Education Authority
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs

occurrences.checkable_against: Holy Evangelists Primary School temperature and heating records
occurrences.quote_span: "Our classrooms can't drop below a certain temperature so we have to keep the heating on.
occurrences.speaker: Claire Robinson
occurrences.subject: Education Authority Northern Ireland school energy costs
